notes: LLM generation must mention >=1 numeric fact from active zone_facts.
Each zone has function tags + objectives + constraints to prevent generic replies.

A1.label: Plot A1
goals: Deliver workspace/jobs without overwhelming local amenity and movement capacity
Make ground floor retail/F&B feel public-facing not gated
Ensure residential delivery is not framed as a ‘bonus’ but tied to access/amenity commitments
discussion_prompts: How should A1 balance workspace delivery with residential impact?
What commitments should be attached to 118k sqft workspace to benefit locals?

A2.label: Plot A2
goals: Make leisure centre a truly public asset (access, pricing, hours)
Use workspace scale to justify local training / hiring commitments
Ensure A2’s mix reduces conflict rather than concentrating it
discussion_prompts: Who gets access to the 55k sqft leisure centre and under what rules?
How should 182k sqft workspace translate into local benefit commitments?

K1.label: Plot K1
goals: Protect affordability long-term (not only at handover)
Make allocation transparent and locally trusted
Prevent displacement narratives by publishing clear safeguards
typical_issues: Who qualifies for the 79 homes (priority rules)?
discussion_prompts: What allocation and eligibility rules ensure the 79 homes benefit locals?
How should the £18m council purchase be communicated to build trust?

GLOBAL.label: Whole District

hard_facts.note: Use when debate is about cross-zone trade-offs rather than one plot.

goals: Keep debate anchored to measurable trade-offs
Avoid drifting into abstract statements without commitments
discussion_prompts: Which constraint is binding this round: climate/economic/ecological pressure?
What minimum commitments apply to all plots?
